title: Accessing the current time in a static initialiser captures the time at class loading, which is rarely desirable.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: This TimeUnit conversion looks buggy: converting from a smaller unit to a larger unit (and passing a constant), converting to/from the same TimeUnit, or converting TimeUnits where the result is statically known to be 0 or 1 are all buggy patterns.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: An value that appears to be represented in one unit is used where another appears to be required (e.g., seconds where nanos are needed).
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.
